score_identity: primary_scale_score = 0.5*((logE30-logE240)+(logE60-logE240)) from trailing 15s endpoint-grid Haar energies smoothed over physical 5 minutes
purpose: test whether the already-frozen V3.2 STAR50 primary scale score can rank future quiet-first-tail risk in the full quiet decision universe without fitting a classifier or defining new morphology features
negative_control_symbol_modeling: none; CSI1000 is not promoted on this route after V3.2 precursor non-confirmation

decision_universe.missing_or_stale_fine_path: exclude from eligible decision rows; never carry forward or impute

label.name: quiet_first_tail_in_t_plus_2_to_t_plus_15
label.definition: within the same half-session, at least one frozen V3 first-tail event with quiet_pre=true occurs at event minute e in [t+2,t+15]
label.why_start_t_plus_2: preserves the V3.2 strict timing boundary: decision close t is at least one minute earlier than the earliest possible onset of event minute e
label.session_boundary: future windows crossing the half-session boundary are not created because decision minute is capped at 105
label.event_identity: frozen V3 quiet_first_tail only; no relabeling from v3.3 outcomes

calibration.reason: fix approximately 20% time coverage while neutralizing half-session clock seasonality; evaluation-year coverage drift is reported rather than repaired

event_metrics: unique quiet-first-tail events with at least one eligible strict prewindow decision
event recall from any flagged decision in [e-15,e-2] intersect eligible decision universe
median maximum strict lead among hit events
prewindow support coverage and complete-prewindow subset recall

random_reference.method: permute complete observed alarm sequences across half-sessions within evaluation year and same morning/afternoon class, preserving within-session alarm autocorrelation and minute-of-half-session structure
random_reference.report: 2.5/50/97.5 percentile of event recall and descriptive fraction randomized recall >= observed

evaluation.comparison_rule: primary scale gate and common-volatility baseline are both reported; no winner selection creates a new rule

interpretation.positive_evidence_requires: the frozen scale score to show higher future quiet-first risk in flagged than Clean rows and event recall above its session-permutation reference in both 2024 and 2025, with no requirement to tune coverage
interpretation.failure_means: the V3.2 event-vs-control precursor does not translate into a stable full-universe risk gate under this fixed design; it does not prove all cross-scale precursors impossible

do_not: fit a classifier or regression model
change the V3.2 primary score formula
use evaluation-year quantiles to force 20% coverage
drop adverse years or session-boundary events after seeing results
treat missing fine observations as unchanged prices
read 2026, returns/PnL, trading or production state
